claims.claim: The item is a Canon EOS 5D Mark II DSLR camera body.
claims.evidence: Witness report photo 0 shows Canon logo and “EOS 5D Mark II” marking; photo 1 shows rear controls with “AF-ON”; photo 2 shows Canon-labeled body/serial sticker.
No shutter count display or diagnostic screen is shown in the witness photos.

claims.claim: There is no fungus or scratch on the lens.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show only the camera body; no lens is shown to assess fungus/scratches.

claims.claim: Original battery and charger are included.
claims.evidence: Witness photos do not show included accessories or the battery/charger.

claims.claim: The camera has never been repaired.
claims.evidence: No service history, internal inspection, or repair marks are shown.

risks.risk: Body-only sale: lens may be missing, which materially changes value.
risks.proof: A photo showing the full kit contents laid out (camera + lens + accessories) or a clear shot of the mount with no lens attached plus confirmation of what is included.
risks.if_unproven: Price as camera body only (no lens/accessories).

risks.risk: Sensor condition (dust, scratches, fungus) and image quality issues not visible from these angles.
risks.proof: A close-up of the sensor area (mirror up) and/or a test shot of a blank wall at high ISO showing dust spots.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed for sensor cleanliness (worst-case: needs cleaning/possible sensor issues).

risks.risk: Shutter wear: shutter count claim cannot be confirmed; high actuation reduces value.
risks.proof: A screenshot/photo of shutter count from camera software or an in-camera/utility readout.
risks.if_unproven: Price as higher-wear unit (worst-case: not low shutter count).

risks.risk: LCD/viewfinder functionality (dead pixels, backlight issues) not tested in the photos.
risks.proof: A short video showing the LCD turning on, menu navigation, and live view; plus a close-up of the LCD for dead pixels.
risks.if_unproven: Price as LCD/viewfinder functionality not confirmed.

risks.risk: Controls/ports may be faulty (AF-ON, buttons, USB/HDMI/AV), not verifiable from static images.
risks.proof: A short clip demonstrating key buttons (including AF-ON) and a connection test (USB to laptop or HDMI output).
risks.if_unproven: Price as untested electronics (worst-case: possible port/button faults).

risks.risk: Physical condition (dents, cracks, worn grips, mount damage) not fully visible in the provided angles.
risks.proof: Full 360° photos: front, back, left/right sides, top, bottom, and close-ups of grip and lens mount area.

risks.risk: Battery/charger health and included items not shown; could be missing or weak.
risks.proof: Photos of the actual battery and charger model/labels, and a clip showing charging and camera powering on.
risks.if_unproven: Price as battery/charger not guaranteed (worst-case: buyer must source replacements).

proof_requests: Send a photo/video showing the complete items included (camera + any lens + strap + body cap + cables + memory card + battery + charger).
Provide a shutter count readout screenshot/photo (from a reliable tool or camera utility).
Show a sensor close-up (mirror up) and/or a high-ISO test shot of a blank surface to reveal dust/scratches.
Show LCD functionality: short video of menu navigation and live view; include a close-up for dead pixels.
Demonstrate key controls (including AF-ON) and a port test (USB or HDMI) via a short clip.
Provide full 360° condition photos, especially the lens mount and grip area.
response.reason: The witness report clearly identifies the camera as a Canon EOS 5D Mark II body, so it can be priced at worst-case for unverified condition/accessories. Missing proof mainly affects accessories, sensor/shutter wear, and functionality, which are handled by worst-case pricing until confirmed.
